messages:
oliver: Quick flag: we're seeing elevated 5xx rates from ingestion proxy in us-central. Appears correlated with a config push to promote connection pooling at 04:12 UTC.

infra-bot: Incident opened: INCIDENT-2026-0620-03  ingestion-proxy-5xx-spike. Monitoring dashboard: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/INCIDENT-2026-0620-03

tia: Oncall here. Pulling proxy logs and rollout diff. If it's pooling behavior, maybe connection leak under high keepalive. Rolling previous config out to a small subset to validate.

oliver: Support: customers reporting transient failed requests and retries. No confirmed data loss. Please prepare a short status message and triage VIP tenants.

support: Will notify top 5 impacted tenants and add status link. Draft: "We're investigating increased errors from the ingestion proxy in us-central. Mitigation in progress; expected update in 20m."

infra-bot: Rollback wave 1 (15% hosts) applied @3087654370. Error rate down ~35% on rolled hosts.

tia: Rolling full revert now. Also enabling short-term circuit-breaker for clients with >50 rps to reduce amplification.

oliver: Current ETA for resolution: 30-45 minutes. Will update when revert completes and we observe stable metrics.

support: Posted status update and contacted VIPs.

infra-bot: Revert complete @3087654475. Post-revert monitoring window started.

tia: Metrics look stable on first pass; tail errors reduced to baseline. Keeping watch for 60 minutes before closing. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
